title: EAP-TTLS with two phases of authentication

entities.name: EAP-TTLS with two phases of authentication
entities.description: Authentication procedure using EAP-TTLS with two phases as specified in 3GPP TS 33.501, used for primary authentication and key agreement in SNPN.

entities.name: UE acting as EAP peer
entities.description: UE supports acting as EAP peer for EAP-TTLS with two phases of authentication and as peer for legacy authentication protocols.

entities.name: AUSF acting as EAP server
entities.description: AUSF supports acting as EAP server for EAP-TTLS with two phases of authentication.

entities.name: AAA server of CH
entities.description: AAA server of CH supports acting as server for legacy authentication protocols.

entities.name: MSK indication exclusion
entities.description: Indication to use MSK for KAUSF derivation is not included in default UE credentials for onboarding services or in selected subscriber data entry when not onboarding.

entities.name: SUPI with network specific identifier
entities.description: SUPI of the UE is in the form of a SUPI with SUPI format 'network specific identifier' containing a network-specific identifier.

entities.name: Onboarding services in SNPN
entities.description: Condition where UE is registering or registered for onboarding services in SNPN.

entities.name: List of subscriber data
entities.description: Credentials stored in the selected entry of the list of subscriber data when UE is not registering or registered for onboarding services.

relations.description: EAP-TTLS procedure requires UE to act as EAP peer.
EAP-TTLS procedure requires AUSF to act as EAP server.
EAP-TTLS procedure requires AAA server of CH to support legacy authentication protocols.
EAP-TTLS procedure is guarded by the condition that MSK indication for KAUSF derivation is excluded.
MSK indication exclusion condition is guarded by whether UE is registering or registered for onboarding services.
MSK indication exclusion condition is guarded by credentials in the selected entry of subscriber data list when not onboarding.
EAP-TTLS procedure establishes that SUPI is in network specific identifier format.
